title: Period-dependent covariance-weighted Rayleigh-wave tomography
summary: Implement an iterative damped inversion with period-specific normalized kernels, heterogeneous data/model covariance, a prior model, and hidden changed geometry and dimensions.
taskPrompt: Read input/spec.md and implement its exact period-dependent iterative update. Derive all output dimensions from JSON, emit four arrays and exact diagnostics units, and run unchanged on evaluator-only hidden inputs.
agentMustDo: Implement reusable covariance-weighted iterative inversion in output/solve.py
Handle differing period kernels and hidden dimensions

inputFiles.name: tomography_input.json
inputFiles.description: Synthetic period-dependent normalized kernels, observations, variances, prior, and damping parameters.

inputFiles.name: spec.md
inputFiles.description: Exact iterative objective, ordering, units, and output contract.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_case.json
referenceFiles.description: Changed period kernels with oblique rays, heterogeneous model/data covariance, observations, and damping.

referenceFiles.name: hidden_dimensions_case.json
referenceFiles.description: Changed grid, period count, ray count, kernels, covariance, and regularization.

evaluation: The evaluator executes solve.py on visible input, then on both hidden inputs, and compares all four arrays and diagnostics to an independent oracle. Components are visible 0.35, diagnostics 0.15, positive-physical invariant 0.15, and hidden recomputation 0.35.
